messages:
mira: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — small fixes to the Python SDK snippet and a link fix. Q: what approvals/checks do I need to merge? docs-preview didn't show for me earlier.

sam: for docs-only we usually want a docs reviewer + green docs-preview check. If the change touches /sdk/ code we treat it as code and need eng review. can you confirm paths? :mag:

mira: it's only `docs/sdk/python/quickstart.md` and one link under `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md` — no runtime code. still picked up by CODEOWNERS though.

kai: current CODEOWNERS has a broad rule for `/sdk/ @eng-platform`, which matches the path here because of the substring. we should make it explicit so docs under `docs/sdk/` are owned by docs. proposal snippet:
```
# CODEOWNERS
/docs/sdk/ @docs-team
/sdk/ @eng-platform
```

sam: that would help a lot. also suggest GH auto-merge only for PRs with label `docs:minor` and when `docs-preview` + `ci` checks are green. don't auto-merge PRs touching `sdk/` actual code.

jordan: the docs-preview action posts a staging link. mira, did it post one for this PR?

mira: it posted https://deploy-preview-412--docs.redwood.ai but images 404 and some syntax highlighting missing. looks like baseURL is wrong on branch.

kai: images 404 usually means the `DOCS_BASE_URL` or site config needs the repo path set for branch previews. I can add a step to the preview action to set `DOCS_BASE_URL` dynamically. small change.

sam: to formalize next steps: 1) update CODEOWNERS to be more granular (kai will open PR), 2) add GH action that allows auto-merge when label `docs:ready` + checks green (sam will draft), 3) update docs PR template to remind authors to add `docs-preview` label (mira will update).

mira: I'll add `docs:ready` to this PR and ping a docs reviewer @carla. also I'll attach the failing screenshot for preview.

carla: happy to review — will check this afternoon. if it's tiny we can merge during the 15:00 docs merge window. :thumbsup:

sam: note — branch protection currently requires `ci` and `docs-preview` to pass. we should make `docs-preview` a required status only for docs paths; otherwise it blocks eng merges. I'll open a ticket to make branch-protection rules path-aware.

docs-bot: Reminder: `docs-preview` runs on push. To re-run the preview, comment with `@docs-bot rerun-preview`.

mira: thanks everyone. I'll update the PR with label and open the CODEOWNERS PR so we don't keep hitting eng for micro docs edits. will post links once done.
